description: Implementation of MockCertVerifier class for testing certificate verification, including request handling, rule management, and observer pattern.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier::Rule
classes.description: Defines verification rules associating certificates, hostnames, results, and return values.

classes.description: Represents a mock request for certificate verification, managing asynchronous result returning.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier
classes.description: Mock implementation of a certificate verifier for testing purposes.

methods.description: Performs certificate verification, either synchronously or asynchronously.
